result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with the restaurant name truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container shows a clear visual affordance (e.g., partial card peek) that is intentional, and make sure the restaurant name does not get cut in a confusing way — consider limiting the name to full words or adding an ellipsis properly.

issues.description: The last category filter pill in the horizontal filter row (after 'Healthy') is partially visible and cut off, showing only a sliver of the next option.
issues.suggestion: This appears to be an intentional peek pattern to indicate scrollability, but consider adding a subtle fade/gradient on the right edge to make it clearer that the row is horizontally scrollable.
